page_title: LEN 1-1 HAV | Lens v Le Havre 06/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Today's referee Francois Letexier rightly decides to book Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) for his harsh tackle.
90+1' Francois Letexier shows a yellow card to Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) for a tough tackle.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Here is a change. Emmanuel Sabbi is going off and Luka Elsner gives the last tactical orders to Simon Ebonog (Le Havre).
90' Today's match ends for Gautier Lloris who will be replaced by Yoann Salmier (Le Havre).
87' Substitution. Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Oussama Targhalline walks off.
87' Chance! Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Angelo Fulgini (Lens) replaces David Pereira da Costa.
85' Lens will take a corner kick.
79' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Andy Diouf will be replaced by Adrien Thomasson (Lens).
79' Substitution. Deiver Machado (Lens) has come on for Jonathan Gradit.
78' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Brice Samba no chance!
77' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) is going to take the penalty!

77' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Francois Letexier blows for a foul. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Le Havre!
74' The substitution is prepared. Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Yassine Kechta.
74' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
74' Luka Elsner has decided to make a change. Josue Casimir (Le Havre) replaces Andre Ayew.
73' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
72' The ball is out of play and Le Havre manage to earn a corner.
71' That will be all from Elye Wahi who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Wesley Said (Lens).
69' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Francois Letexier didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
68' Dangerous play by David Pereira da Costa (Lens). Francois Letexier blows his whistle for a foul.
65' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
64' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
63' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
62' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francois Letexier had an easy-decision to make.
62' Flag up against Florian Sotoca (Lens). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

59' 1 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top of the net. Arthur Desmas just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:0.
55' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Lens players look gutted.
54' Wait! Referee Francois Letexier has indicated he is going to review the Lens goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
53' Goal! Florian Sotoca (Lens) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 0:0.
51' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) sees a yellow card from Francois Letexier after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
49' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) is replaced by Neil El Aynaoui.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Francois Letexier blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Florian Sotoca (Lens) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Le Havre have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
44' Le Havre quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
44' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Le Havre force their opponents to concede a corner.
41' The photographers scatter as a shot from the edge of the box by Andy Diouf (Lens) blazes well wide of the right post.
41' Andy Diouf (Lens) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
40' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ruben Aguilar (Lens). Corner kick. Lens will have an opportunity.
38' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
38' Loic Nego (Le Havre) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Good work from Le Havre as they win a corner.
37' Facundo Medina (Lens) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
36' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Andy Diouf (Lens), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

35' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
34' Andy Diouf (Lens) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
33' Elye Wahi (Lens) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
32' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Arthur Desmas, who smothers the ball.

31' What a chance that is! Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
30' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
27' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
22' The foul by Andy Diouf (Lens) was seen by Francois Letexier who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
20' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) sends a rebound goalwards, low to the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper is there to stop it.
17' Lens earn a corner.

17' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the bottom left corner, but he can't get the power to direct it past Arthur Desmas, who gets down to save.

15' Elye Wahi (Lens) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Elye Wahi (Lens) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. The ball is out of play. Lens will have a chance to score from a corner.
11' Oh, what a chance! Elye Wahi (Lens) was quickest to the rebound but the ball hit the crossbar.
11' Andy Diouf (Lens) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

10' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Lens have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
7' Arthur Desmas was forced into action to thwart Elye Wahi (Lens). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper.
5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lens.
4' Andy Diouf (Lens) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

3' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lens.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lens will have the kick-off.
Francois Letexier is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
Show lineups
